name: Hanuman Temple
town_description: Noklak is a remote town in far-eastern Nagaland, headquarters of Noklak district (carved out of Tuensang district in 2021). It is the homeland of the Khiamniungan Naga tribe and sits near the Myanmar border. The population is overwhelmingly Christian, with only a tiny Hindu presence.
